kernels.title: Vector tour
kernels.label: INT8
kernels.description: The vector_tour conformance program: loads a mask, two R_CYCLIC slots and R0/R1, then runs MULT.VE, MULT.RC.VV/VS/VE and MULT.EE into ACC.ADD/SUB/MAX, masked multiplies, and a 4-row matrix-vector loop with AGG.SUM.FIRST. INT8 lanes multiply into INT32 MULT_RES and R_ACC; the run ends with ACTIVATE.QUANTIZE RELU and a store of POST_AAQ_REG.

kernels.title: Vector tour
kernels.label: FP8 E4M3
kernels.description: The vector_tour conformance program: loads a mask, two R_CYCLIC slots and R0/R1, then runs MULT.VE, MULT.RC.VV/VS/VE and MULT.EE into ACC.ADD/SUB/MAX, masked multiplies, and a 4-row matrix-vector loop with AGG.SUM.FIRST. FP8 E4M3 lanes multiply into FP32 MULT_RES and R_ACC. ACTIVATE.QUANTIZE needs INT8, so results leave through stores of R_ACC.

kernels.title: Vector tour
kernels.label: FP8 E5M2
kernels.description: The vector_tour conformance program: loads a mask, two R_CYCLIC slots and R0/R1, then runs MULT.VE, MULT.RC.VV/VS/VE and MULT.EE into ACC.ADD/SUB/MAX, masked multiplies, and a 4-row matrix-vector loop with AGG.SUM.FIRST. FP8 E5M2: wider range and 2 mantissa bits, so products round more coarsely than in E4M3.

kernels.title: Vector tour
kernels.label: FP8 E3M4
kernels.description: The vector_tour conformance program: loads a mask, two R_CYCLIC slots and R0/R1, then runs MULT.VE, MULT.RC.VV/VS/VE and MULT.EE into ACC.ADD/SUB/MAX, masked multiplies, and a 4-row matrix-vector loop with AGG.SUM.FIRST. FP8 E3M4: 4 mantissa bits, narrow range.

kernels.title: Fully connected
kernels.label: INT8
kernels.description: Dense layer, 10 samples × 128 inputs → 64 outputs on native 128 × INT8 vectors, accumulated in INT32 R_ACC. One word per input element: LR address updates, MULT.RC.VE, ACC.ADD, the next weight-row load and the loop branch.

kernels.title: Fully connected
kernels.label: FP8 E4M3
kernels.description: The same dense layer on native FP8 E4M3 vectors with FP32 accumulation.

kernels.title: Fully connected
kernels.label: FP8 E5M2
kernels.description: The same dense layer on native FP8 E5M2 vectors with FP32 accumulation.

kernels.title: Fully connected
kernels.label: INT32
kernels.description: The default fully_connected case, in the emulator-only INT32 element format.

kernels.title: Identity copy
kernels.label: FP32
kernels.description: Copies a 3 × 128 FP32 matrix one XMEM row at a time: MULT.VE by the hardware constant 1.0 (CR1), ACC.ADD.FIRST, ACTIVATE.QUANTIZE, then a store of POST_AAQ_REG.

kernels.title: Channel peak
kernels.label: FP32
kernels.description: Detector confidence over 4 channels × 16 cells: ACC.MAX across channel planes, ACC.SUB of the threshold, ReLU gate via ACTIVATE.QUANTIZE.

kernels.title: Row softmax
kernels.label: FP32
kernels.description: Numerically stable softmax over 2 rows: AGG.MAX for the row maximum, the native exp2 activation, AGG.SUM for the denominator, MULT.EE to normalise.

kernels.title: Depth to space
kernels.label: FP32
kernels.description: Pixel shuffle, upscale factor 2, 2 × 8 grid. ACC.RESHAPE scatters eight MULT_RES elements per instruction into arbitrary R_ACC slots, indexed by LRD pairs.

kernels.title: 3×3 convolution
kernels.label: FP32
kernels.description: Standard 3×3 conv2d. Three vertically neighbouring 128-element input chunks rotate through the four R_CYCLIC slots; each tap is one MULT.RC.VE (all 128 lanes × one weight) and an ACC.ADD into R_ACC. Edge lanes are masked.

kernels.title: Residual add
kernels.label: FP32
kernels.description: FP32 element-wise add of two 64-channel tensors: MULT.RC.VE by 1.0 copies each chunk, ACC.ADD.FIRST and ACC.ADD sum them, and a store writes R_ACC back.
